response.sql: SELECT transactionrecord.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as matched_count FROM advancedbehavior INNER JOIN transactionrecord ON transactionrecord.transreg = advancedbehavior.translink WHERE advancedbehavior.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY transactionrecord.ordertypedist ORDER BY transactionrecord.ordertypedist;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff of 0.439 is inclusive (patsim >= 0.439), which is standard for threshold-based filtering where the cutoff value itself is included in the 'high similarity' group.

alternatives.interpretation: If 'cutoff' means the boundary is excluded (values strictly above it), use > instead of >=
